required_controls: Release SHA/version, actual readiness, uptime, queue lag, provider incidents, cost and red/amber health. No hardcoded preview version as live truth.
verification: Boot probe and synthetic enquiry-to-invoice; prove failed dependencies surface.

required_controls: Tenant search, lifecycle, plans, entitlements, roles, authorized support grant and export/deletion requests. Impersonation must be explicit, scoped, expiring and audited.
verification: Wrong-tenant read and delegated support expiry tests.

required_controls: Versioned prices, tax settings, subscriptions, usage meters, partner costs, invoices, refunds, disputes and reconciliation. Separate operational credits from money custody.
verification: Duplicate webhook, wrong amount, failed settlement, refund permissions.

required_controls: Founder recovery, operator roles, MFA, sessions, devices, joiner/mover/leaver workflow and reviewed access grants.
verification: Subscriber owner cannot call operator APIs; revoke operator sessions immediately.

required_controls: Provider capability by action and tenant; encrypted credential metadata only, owner, scope, expiry, last verified, reconnect action, test/live distinction and supplier incident.
verification: Never return secrets; invalid/revoked grant disables only affected tenant/action.

required_controls: Orders, quotes, approvals, number/domain/assistant resources, pending KYC, callbacks, reconciliation, renewals, cancellations and orphan cleanup.
verification: Crash after provider success must reconcile rather than buy twice.

required_controls: Scheduler health, leases, attempts, dead letters, dry-run preview, pause switches and approval-bound recovery actions.
verification: No double sends/charges from replay; operator cannot replay another business unintentionally.

required_controls: Model/provider catalogue, budgets, knowledge isolation, versioned prompts, eval results, redacted traces, safety escalations and human handoff.
verification: Injection tests, provider outage fallback, language and tool-call evaluation.

required_controls: Primary/backup location, backup age/integrity, restore history, recovery owner, RPO/RTO, expiry and verified drill. A backup uploaded is not a restore proven.
verification: Recover a separate temporary environment without production writes.

required_controls: Dependency/SBOM inventory, release artifacts, migrations, approvals, canary, deployment evidence, rollback and flags. Approved human-controlled execution first.
verification: Deploy exact artifact to isolated preview; forward/backward schema checks and rollback rehearsal.

required_controls: Severity, owner, affected tenant/services, timeline, communication drafts, escalation, postmortem, corrective actions and support SLA.
verification: Simulated provider outage creates one incident and routes alert without exposing PII.

required_controls: ASVS evidence, findings, export permissions, consent/retention, subprocessor register, breach workflow, DSAR and legal holds.
verification: Audit access control, redaction, retention/deletion propagation and tamper detection.

required_controls: Selectable locale list, pilot dictionary keys, saved preference counts, honest coverage and pending language release gates. Extend to per-screen review and translation workflow.
verification: Operator-only endpoint; no user identifiers; RTL/device/native-speaker signoff required.

required_controls: Feature ownership, release flags by tenant/plan/country, API versions, regional defaults, template versions, change history and rollback.
verification: Changes require server permission, revision conflict handling and recorded actor.

required_controls: Requirements, decisions, releases, approvals, supplier agreements, licence expiries, runbooks, test evidence and resumable checkpoints.
verification: Every completed task links artifact SHA, tests, owner and next action; restore handover on fresh checkout.
